auth_config_env: INVOKEAI_MULTIUSER (invokeai.yaml: multiuser, default false — disabled means single-user mode with a default admin-privileged account and no login)
INVOKEAI_STRICT_PASSWORD_CHECKING (invokeai.yaml: strict_password_checking, default false — only relevant once multiuser is enabled)
misconfig_patterns: multiuser defaults to false — operators who set host: 0.0.0.0 (or --host 0.0.0.0) for LAN/remote access expose a fully-privileged default admin session to anyone who connects, no login screen

Pre-6.13.7: GET /api/v1/app/runtime_config could disclose invokeai.yaml and api_keys.yaml contents (model-download bearer tokens for Civitai/HuggingFace, remote image-gen provider keys for OpenAI/Alibaba/etc.) to any network-reachable client when host was bound 0.0.0.0 — fixed by response redaction (_redact_config_secrets) in 6.13.7
Unauthenticated POST /api/v2/models/install accepted attacker-supplied model files deserialized via torch.load with no validation — CVE-2024-12029, RCE, CVSS 9.8/9.0, versions 5.3.1-5.4.2
Unauthenticated POST /api/v1/images/upload multipart-boundary parsing DoS — CVE-2024-10821
Unauthenticated PATCH /api/v1/boards/{board_id} with oversized board_name payload — CVE-2024-11043 resource exhaustion
Unauthenticated path traversal via media/output directory endpoints allowed arbitrary file read outside the intended directory, versions <6.7.0 — CVE-2025-6237
GET /api/v1/images/ and board listing endpoints disclose generated image history, prompts, and output filenames — product-IP and potential NSFW/PII content class disclosure
GET /api/v2/models/ enumerates full installed-model inventory, fingerprinting operator's compute/workflow investment

active_probe.false_positive_check: Response must be JSON with a single top-level "version" key holding a semver-like string (e.g. "5.x.x", "6.x.x"); confirm platform identity by chaining a second GET to /api/v1/app/app_deps or /api/v2/models/ (installed-model list) before labeling — bare {"version":...} alone is a weak marker shared by many FastAPI apps

deployment_tells: [INFERRED — not confirmed by a  survey] Default port 9090, but by ComfyUI-sibling precedent expect a meaningful share on alt/proxied ports via cloud GPU rental platforms (RunPod, Vast.ai, Modal) since InvokeAI targets the same self-hosted Stable Diffusion operator base
[INFERRED] Same operator profile as ComfyUI — hobbyist/prosumer GPU owners running on residential ISPs with host:0.0.0.0 for phone/tablet access to the web UI, no reverse proxy
[INFERRED] multiuser=false is the overwhelmingly common real-world state since it is the shipped default and enabling it requires deliberate config-file or env-var action

Docker distributions exist with bundled auth wrappers (e.g. ai-dock/invokeai adds Nginx basic-auth) — presence of a basic-auth prompt in front of the UI indicates a hardened deployment, absence indicates default posture
pivot_paths: GET /api/v1/app/version → InvokeAI version string (CVE-scoping: <5.4.3rc2 = CVE-2024-12029 candidate, <6.7.0 = CVE-2025-6237 candidate, <6.13.7 = config-disclosure candidate)
GET /api/v1/app/runtime_config → full app config (redacted for secrets on patched builds; unredacted on pre-6.13.7 builds reachable at 0.0.0.0)
POST /api/v2/models/install → unauth model-file install path; RCE vector on unpatched versions (CVE-2024-12029)
GET /api/v1/images/ → generated image history + metadata (prompt/output disclosure)
GET /api/v1/boards/ → board (project/collection) listing, operator activity organization
POST /api/v1/images/upload → unauth multipart upload surface (DoS vector on unpatched versions, CVE-2024-10821)
GET /api/v1/queue/{queue_id}/list → pending/active generation jobs (operator activity, compute theft surface if enqueue also reachable)
vulnerabilities: CVE-2024-12029 — Deserialization of Untrusted Data (torch.load, no validation) in POST /api/v2/models/install; unauthenticated RCE; CVSS 9.8; affects 5.3.1-5.4.2; fixed 5.4.3rc2
CVE-2024-10821 — Uncontrolled Resource Consumption / DoS via malformed multipart boundary in POST /api/v1/images/upload; unauthenticated
CVE-2024-11043 — Uncontrolled Resource Consumption / DoS via oversized board_name in PATCH /api/v1/boards/{board_id}, observed v5.0.2
CVE-2025-6237 — Path Traversal allowing unauthenticated arbitrary file read outside the intended media directory; affects <6.7.0; fixed 6.7.0

Unnumbered (fixed 6.13.7, no CVE ID located) — invokeai.yaml / api_keys.yaml (model-download tokens, remote image-gen provider API keys) recoverable by a network-reachable client via config endpoints on hosts bound 0.0.0.0 through 6.13.6; fixed by response secret-redaction in 6.13.7
